191a — 3D: restore control, real Mac acceptance, stable head
tracking (architect design, owner 16:59 asked the architect to
own design/shader)

read: ARCHITECT-INBOX 21:09 post-mortem (owner-ordered 21:02:29)
read: NOW.md 21:00 (live GOR tip 797e2ffb, capture 204251)
Owner 20:58-21:04: the converted film opened VR180, the source
menu is gone, Shift+V and 3D cannot turn it off, and there is no
way to choose 2D→VR180.

A. Restore control first. Nothing else lands before A on the
   Mac.
A1. The 3D state is three independent axes, never one boolean.
    - SOURCE: Auto, 2D, SBS full, SBS half, Top-bottom,
      VR180 SBS, VR180 TB, VR360 mono, VR360 TB
    - OUTPUT: Off (as source), SBS, Half-SBS, Top-bottom,
      VR180, Anaglyph
    - EFFECTS: head tracking, blink, recenter, IPD, cross-eye,
      each independent and valid with OUTPUT Off and plain 2D
    - For a 2D source, a stereo OUTPUT means conversion. For a
      stereo source, OUTPUT means re-presentation: native
      VR180 → SBS works, as does native SBS → VR180 window.
    - Everything sits in ONE "3D" menu with short labels, as
      the owner ordered at 16:04. One menu, never one button.
      Restore Shift+V and the Cmd+Ctrl+Opt shortcuts removed in
      e1046888.
A2. Off always wins.
    - The 3D master toggle switches OUTPUT between Off and the
      last non-Off output.
    - Off is stored per file. No auto-detect, provisional or
      pending state and no remembered state may override it,
      on reopen too.
    - Off returns the exact original film: no projection, no
      crop beyond measured black bars, no SBS split.
A3. Auto-detect promotes a SOURCE projection ONLY from:
    - container metadata (FFmpeg AVSphericalMapping /
      AVStereo3D side data; MKV Projection and StereoMode
      elements; MP4 sv3d/st3d)
    - explicit filename tags (180, VR180, LR, TB, SBS, 360)
    Geometry (aspect, width, circle edges) may only SUGGEST,
    shown as "Auto: looks like SBS?". It never switches
    projection. Remove the geometry promotion from f327a4d9.
    Log vrOpenDecision with its reason for every file.
A4. Tests run compiled on the owner's Mac through the update
    self-test, not as source-text pins. They walk the real menu
    and routing across every SOURCE × OUTPUT pair and through
    load→probe→pending→ready→Off→reopen. Pass condition: pixels
    equal the source when Off. Include the owner's converted
    "magnet" file case: Off must work and SOURCE must show 2D.

B. Real conversion completes on the Mac
B1. 204251: background 3D FAIL rc -15 at 321 s in prepare.
    rc -15 means a SIGTERM. Name the sender (our watchdog,
    updater cap, or launchd) from the logs. If it is our own
    bound, the bound is wrong for this stage.
B2. Add in-stage progress to prepare: frames done / total for
    cuts, depth (per window), MoGe keyframes, stereo synthesis.
    Heartbeat lines in the existing log, so slow vs stuck is
    measured, not guessed.
B3. Self-test uses a short fixed clip (Tears of Steel, CC-BY),
    so the full prepare → SBS → VR180 path finishes inside its
    announced duration. A self-test result is PASS only when it
    returns SBS + VR180 frame grabs, the FoV track and ms per
    stage.
B4. Licence: 190w W1 IS the architect ruling (MoGe-2 MIT;
    nunif weights MIT, owner-Mac private use, Depth-Pro
    provenance caveat in NOTICE). The post-mortem may cite it as
    ratified.

C. Head tracking that does not drift or breathe
C1. Pose comes from Apple Vision face landmarks, not box size:
    - VNFaceObservation roll/yaw/pitch
    - Z from the inter-pupil landmark distance divided by
      cos(yaw), not from the bounding box
C2. Filter every channel with a One Euro filter (Casiez 2012):
    low jitter at rest, low lag on real motion. Add hysteresis
    on Z: zoom only after a sustained forward/back change, so a
    still head gives exactly zero zoom. Engineers pick the
    constants and measure them on a recorded still-head and
    lean-in clip from the owner's camera. Never ask the owner
    for numbers.
C3. Tilt keeps fusion at any angle in converted modes. Each
    eye's view is rendered from the depth at the real eye
    positions given by head roll (re-projection), not by
    rotating a fixed-baseline pair. Native stereo keeps its
    baked baseline. That is why native VR180 behaved and must
    stay unchanged.
C4. Shift+R: full-fit at the original aspect ratio, centred,
    zoom reset. Shift+D toggles the 3D master (A2).
C5. Record a per-frame pose trace (raw, filtered, the uniform
    sent) in the self-test log. Closure is that trace, not
    synthetic jitter stats. Fix the HeadTrackVisionOnce test
    regression at 797e2ffb first.

D. Completion language (post-mortem section 6, now a rule)
- To the owner, "fixed" or "çalışıyor" may only be said with:
  - the delivered pin
  - the Mac capture ID showing that behaviour
  - the verdict
- Otherwise say "kaynakta var, Mac'inde henüz doğrulanmadı".
- No owner run is requested while a newer commit is landing.
  Freeze, deliver one pin, then ask once.

E. Order: A (restore), then B and C in parallel, then the next
   owner update. Heat stays paused. No owner gate is touched.

191b — 3D state, menu and keys: architect redesign from scratch
(owner 22:01:06 "MENÜYÜ VE ANAHTARLARI BAŞTAN TASARLASIN")

read: ARCHITECT-INBOX 22:03 source audit (installed pin 0d0f37b9)
read: archive/gor/Sources/gor/ThreeDWiring.swift @0d0f37b9
read: archive/gor/Sources/gor/ThreeDMenu.swift @0d0f37b9
read: archive/gor/Sources/gor/LookToolsRoute.swift @0d0f37b9
  (SourceFormatChoice, SingleSwitchRoute, applySingleSwitch)
Peer facts (gdb 22:03, not re-read by the architect):
  PPController.swift:3362/:2671, PPController_Features.swift
  :735/:862, AppDelegate.swift:483/:1253/:2830, :3782 test hook

ROOT CAUSE (architect read, confirm with the Mac trace in 191b-T)
3D state lives in three stores with three different keys and
several writers:
  1. global gor.3d.mode (ThreeDSettings). The prepare timer in
     ThreeDWiring reads THIS, not the per-film choice.
  2. gor.3d.sourceByFilm.v1 (+.off/.output/.lastOutput), keyed
     by currentFilePath. That can be a generated
     render_shot_N.mp4, while routing uses recognitionPath.
  3. gor.vr.fileChoices.v184 plus sessionProjectionChoices,
     keyed by recognitionIdentity.
Writers that fight:
  - applySingleSwitch: writes lastOutput (default full_sbs) as
    the output at load, so a film turns 3D on by itself.
  - refreshPreview: re-applies the stored value on every
    refresh, so a menu pick reverts.
  - resetForFileChange: forces projection vr180.
  - autoSelectProjection: turns VR on from detection.
  - the gor-test-vr-mode hook: bypasses the menu.
  - controller?.onSourceResolved: dropped when the controller is
    nil or the VR180Controller is created lazily.
Patching single writers cannot converge. Replace the structure.

B1. One state, one owner
- New file ThreeDState.swift. Pure value plus reducer, no AppKit,
  testable on Linux:
    struct FilmThreeD { source: Source; output: Output;
      lastOutput: Output; userTouched: Bool }
    Source: auto, flat2D, sbsFull, sbsHalf, tbFull, tbHalf,
      vr180SBS, vr180TB, vr360Mono, vr360TB, each with a swap
      flag
    Output: off, sbs, halfSBS, tb, vr180, anaglyph
    Effects (global, not per film): head, blink, crossEye, ipd,
      strength, screenDepth, screenSize, surround, quality,
      osdLine
    enum Action: open(FilmID, Evidence), setSource, setOutput,
      toggle3D, cycleSource, setEffect, resetView
    func reduce(state, action) -> (state, [Effect])
- ThreeDStore (main actor, single instance) is the ONLY writer of
  3D state. Menu, keys, OSD commands, IPC/script messages,
  acceptance runner and test hooks all call
  store.dispatch(action). Nothing else may call
  setVRModeEnabled, publishProjection, select3DOutput or write a
  3D defaults key.
- The applier subscribes to the store. It diffs desired vs
  applied presentation and sends idempotent commands to mpv /
  vr180-look / the coordinator. No timers or polling re-apply
  state. The menu reads the store in validateMenuItem only.
- The subscription replaces onSourceResolved and
  onSingleSwitchResolved, so controller creation order can no
  longer drop an event.

B2. Film identity
- FilmID = the original source's recognitionIdentity (the
  existing StableCacheKey for files; normalized URL for streams
  and magnets). It is never currentFilePath.
- Generated media (render_shot_N.mp4, prepared caches) are marked
  internal at load. They inherit the parent FilmID, do NOT run
  resetForFileChange, and never write or read their own entry.
- One defaults key: gor.3d.films.v2 = [FilmID: FilmThreeD],
  capped at the last 2000 films, oldest evicted.
- Migrate once from keys 2 and 3 above: take the owner's explicit
  per-file choices only. Then stop reading AND writing every old
  3D key (gor.3d.mode, sourceByFilm.v1.*, vr.fileChoices.v184,
  sessionProjectionChoices). Leave the old values in place; this
  block does not delete them.
- The prepare launcher reads store.output(for: film), not a
  global mode.

B3. Precedence at open (pure function, unit-tested)
1. userTouched entry for this FilmID: exact restore, Off
   included. Nothing below can override it.
2. Container metadata (AVSphericalMapping / AVStereo3D side data,
   MKV Projection/StereoMode, MP4 sv3d/st3d):
   - sets source
   - for native VR it sets output = vr180, native presentation,
     no conversion (keeps today's native VR behaviour, no feature
     loss)
3. Explicit filename tag (180/VR180/LR/TB/SBS/360): same as 2.
4. Otherwise source = flat2D, output = off.
   - A plain film ALWAYS opens 2D.
   - Geometry may only show "looks like SBS?" in the menu and
     never switches anything.
- Delete applySingleSwitch's lastOutput write and
  autoSelectProjection's geometry path. Both are superseded
  by 1-4.

B4. Menu: one "3D" menu, short labels, the state always visible
  3D: <Output> · <Source>          (status line, disabled)
  3D On/Off                      ⇧D
  ─
  View: Off · SBS ⇧S · Half SBS · Top/Bottom · VR180 ⇧V ·
        Anaglyph
  Film is: Auto (<detected>) · 2D · SBS · Half SBS ·
        Top/Bottom · Half T/B · VR180 SBS · VR180 T/B ·
        360 · 360 T/B · Swap eyes        (cycle ⇧F)
  ─
  Depth: stronger ⇧= · weaker ⇧- · (shows current)
  Screen: nearer ⌥⇧= · farther ⌥⇧- · (shows current)
  Size (VR180): larger ⌥⇧] · smaller ⌥⇧[
  Eyes: IPD + ⇧] · IPD − ⇧[ · Cross-eye ⇧X
  Head tracking ⇧H · Blink ⇧E · Recenter / full fit ⇧R
  Surround: Black · Soft
  Quality: Auto · Best · Fast   (rows for tiers that are not
    built are hidden, not shown "not implemented")
  Show 3D info on screen
- Every 3D change shows a one-line OSD:
  "3D SBS · film 2D · converting 34%" / "3D off".
- Depth / Screen / Size are live steps with an OSD value. The
  owner tunes by eye and is never asked for numbers. Remove the
  numeric submenus.
- Shift+V means View VR180, and toggles back to Off if already
  VR180.
- Remove the Cmd+Ctrl+Opt shortcuts.

B5. Key safety
- Before landing: list every existing gor/mpv binding (input.conf,
  MenuActions, InputController, AppDelegate) against B4.
- On a collision: keep the existing non-3D binding (zero feature
  loss), move the 3D key to ⌥ plus the same key, and report each
  move in one line.
- One keymap table drives both the menu key equivalents and the
  keyboard path, so they can never diverge.

B6. Off is exact
- Output off means:
  - the source pixels as decoded
  - no projection, SBS split or 3D crop
  - measured black-bar crop only, as in 2D gor
  - prepare paused, not cancelled; cache kept
- Toggling back resumes from cache.

191b-T. Acceptance, compiled on the owner's Mac via the
update self-test
- The runner dispatches store actions and drives real menu items
  via NSMenu performActionForItem. Assert the presented pixels
  and the applied mpv/vr180-look state, not text pins.
- Matrix: every Source × Output pair, plus the sequences below.
  1. Plain film opens 2D → ⇧S → SBS stays SBS through 3 render
     shot swaps and 2 min of playback (the owner's 21:58
     complaint).
  2. SBS → ⇧V → VR180 → ⇧D Off → close → reopen: still Off, and
     pixels equal the source.
  3. Native VR180 with metadata opens VR180. ⇧D gives the exact
     equirect frame flat.
  4. The owner's converted "magnet" file: opens 2D, Off works,
     and Film is shows 2D.
  5. Every key in B4 does what its menu row does (one table).
- Per-case artifacts: action log, store snapshots, applied
  commands, one frame grab, pass/fail. Aggregate-only FAIL is not
  a result.
- Fold the gor-test-vr-mode hook into store.dispatch. Delete the
  bypass.

ORDER
- 191b replaces 191a A1-A3 and is 191a A4's acceptance.
- 191a B (prepare SIGTERM, in-stage progress) and C (landmark
  tracking) continue in parallel. They must not touch the store,
  menu or keys.
- Main freezes, delivers ONE pin, then reports the 191b-T result
  and the capture ID to the owner in Turkish. No owner run is
  requested while a newer commit is landing.

OCR lineage (190y Y2.3, 21:20), architect ruling: route 1.
- Import the P3.3c changes as patches onto kni main 3c7ed2d5.
- Rerun the independent full suite on the new commit, then merge.
- No unrelated-histories merge, and no promotion of the OCR
  lineage.
KNI policies (21:19): the architect answers on the next read.

No owner gate touched.
